slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked whether exactly one protein must be selected or whether salmon, beef, and pork can be combined. Turn 7's broad 'additional constraints' question did not specifically target the protein-selection rule; the simulator volunteered it.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any additional constraints on the meal plan, such as a maximum weight for any single food item, a requirement to include at least one vegetable, or a limit on the number of different foods that can be selected?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched vegetable inclusion and number of foods, but it asked about including at least one vegetable rather than explicitly asking whether at least two different vegetable types are required. The simulator volunteered the at-least-two rule.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without explicitly asking the P1 hidden-slot questions for protein selection or minimum vegetable types. Although the simulator volunteered both facts in turn 7, the agent's own pre-READY questions did not resolve them under the slot-hit rules.

summary: The agent clarified several numerical and continuous-variable details, but its only coverage of the two hidden structural constraints was a vague catch-all question that let the simulator volunteer them. It did not explicitly ask about the one-protein rule or the at-least-two-vegetable rule.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
